notes: Consumption window and video notes. The self-metered usage panel now answers for any UTC-day range: two day inputs plus 7 DAYS / 30 DAYS / MONTH TO DATE shortcuts drive GET /api/usage/self?from=&to=, which refuses a malformed, impossible or inverted window with an honest 400 instead of guessing one, clamps a span past the 90-day retention and says so, and keeps the historical 7-day answer unchanged when no parameters travel. EXPORT JSON writes exactly the window on screen as a local file (no endpoint, no upload), the title and the REQUESTS/COST chip labels follow the window so nothing claims seven days over a range, an empty window says so instead of showing unexplained zeros, and daily budget rings show the guardrail USD/token caps only when a cap is actually set - an absent cap renders nothing and an unknown state draws no arc. Telegram round video notes now enter the same speech-to-text path as voice notes (the mp4 audio track is already what the decoder selects), with the 5 MB pre-download cap reading both file_size and byte_size so a field-name change cannot bypass it. Docs: the usage route contract and the voice/video-note legs. Quality: core 2487/2487, console smoke 558/558, setup wizard 123/123, locale packs 1555 per pack, publish gate READY, E2E batch green (36 scripts plus the two known helpers).
